applies_when: Observed facts match one declared development role: final circular primitive, single +Z through-cut tool, or repeated +Z through-cut tool.

claim: The three source-linked development cases directly use OCP.BRepPrimAPI.BRepPrimAPI_MakeCylinder for their declared final-primitive or through-cut-tool role.

blind, angled, offset, or unsupported hole patterns
disjoint, fused, filleted, chamfered, or arbitrary geometry

runtime_action: If and only if the declared scope is met, recommend OCP.BRepPrimAPI.BRepPrimAPI_MakeCylinder as the primitive action; otherwise recommend no action. This experimental card is not mounted, injected, or retrieved.
